title: Owner: darker ink for the phone header wordmark and tab labels in light theme
context: In light theme inside BottomBarShell, the 'field notes' header wordmark measures 2.93:1 (WCAG asks 3.0 at 23 points) and the 11-point tab label 'Today' 3.95:1 (asks 4.5), by Flutter's textContrastGuideline at 384x832 (risk 01M3ZZ4FWWPMHDW8XSBAMMSC1B). These are prototype colours from Lane 2.
options: Use a darker ink in light theme so they reach the WCAG minimum
outcome: The owner said "Use the darker ink for those too." Light theme only, on the shell branch: the header wordmark and the tab bar labels get a darker ink that meets textContrastGuideline, proven by a test over the phone shell chrome. Dark theme and the over-scene Meadow colours are unchanged unless the same test shows them failing.
